acr.description: Assetto Corsa Rally, developed by Supernova Games Studios and published by 505 Games

resources.replacementChinesePacenotesDescription: Download acr.7z, copy its acr folder into the game root, and replace all files when prompted.

experimental.unverifiedBuild: This ACR version has not been verified. The required FMOD interface is present, but compatibility is not guaranteed and injection may crash the game. Try experimental injection for this session?
experimental.interfaceMissing: The required FMOD interface is missing or the library is unsupported. Bridge injection was blocked.
experimental.disabled: Experimental live bridge is not enabled.
experimental.enableWarning: This internal feature can inject a DLL into Assetto Corsa Rally. It is intended only for offline or private testing. Game updates can make it incompatible, and using injected code may violate the game's rules or affect an account. Enable the experimental live bridge?
experimental.injectWarning: Inject the internal live-pacenote bridge into the running Assetto Corsa Rally process? Use it only for offline or private testing. The bridge remains loaded until the game exits.
experimental.statusBundleUnavailable: Internal ACR bridge files are not installed in this build.
experimental.statusGameNotRunning: Waiting for Assetto Corsa Rally to start.
experimental.statusInjected: Experimental bridge is already loaded. Exit Assetto Corsa Rally to remove it.
experimental.statusReady: Ready for an explicit experimental bridge injection.
experimental.launchPromptWarning: This experimental feature injects a DLL into Assetto Corsa Rally. It can be incompatible after a game update and may violate the game's rules or put an account at risk. Use it only for offline or private testing. Inject the live-pacenote bridge for this game session?

experimental.privilegeWarning: ZTMZ and Assetto Corsa Rally must run at the same Windows privilege level or the bridge cannot deliver pacenotes. We recommend running both as a normal user; if one is run as administrator, run the other as administrator too.
experimental.protonWarning: On Linux, ZTMZ starts the bundled Windows relay with the same Proton runner and prefix as ACR. Keep ACR running before using Inject bridge.

prerequisite.sharedMemoryReady: Assetto Corsa Rally uses shared memory. No prerequisite check is required.
prerequisite.protonBridgeReady: Assetto Corsa Rally telemetry and live pacenotes are received through the local Proton relay.
